PB39-X01.name: The OracleTwentyOneBirds 3 The-Penpress
PB39-X01.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as "Pentan".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can discard three cards from your decktop. Then, you can return two "Song Bird" family cards, besides any "The-Penpress", from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Pentan"/"Empereur"/"Penpress" can't be blocked by opposing LV2/LV3 Spirits and opposing LV4/LV5 Ultimates.

PB39-003.name: Oracle 3 Over Penpress
PB39-003.effect:
This card is also treated as "Pentan".

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
Once per turn, when your Green/Yellow "Song Bird" family Spirit is summoned/[advents], you can draw a card.

[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
The symbol of every attacking Spirit/Ultimate on its lowest LV that isn't in the "Song Bird" family is fixed as 0.

[Flash]
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block.

PB39-X04.name: Pentan Silk Hat
PB39-X04.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent, if you control any "The Partner Pentan", your counter +1.

[B Engage: Contract Advent Spirit with "The Partner Pentan" as pre-advent]
(Once per Game: Same Name) When braving with the target, you can activate the following effect:
█ Put three cores from the Void to any of your "Pentan".

[During Brave] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can pay one cost to summon a "Song Bird" family card with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters from your Hand/Removed Zone/Soul State. Also, if you have six counters or more, during this battle, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

PB39-X03.name: The DoomBirdLord Ragna-Pentan
PB39-X03.effect:
Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([Yellow Core][Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Exhaust opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of LV9. After this effect resolves, put this card onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, every opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block. Then, when summoned via an effect, refresh three "Pentan" Spirits/Ultimates you control.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
Every "Pentan" you control gains +10000 BP.

PB39-001.name: The Gentleman Pentan
PB39-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Pen Contract, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -5000 BP. When it is brought to 0 BP by this effect, you can return it to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't block.

PB39-X02.name: The God Pentan
PB39-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Pen Contract & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can add a "Pentan" Spirit/Ultimate you control to underneath this Spirit as a pre-advent card. When you've done so, refresh this Spirit, and return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, by summoning a "Song Bird" family card among this Spirit's pre-advent cards without paying the cost, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

PB39-002.name: The President Pentan
PB39-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Pen Contract & C3 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Draw two cards. Then, by discarding up to two cards from your Hand, for each card discarded, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate that is at its highest LV to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (When Attacks)
During this turn, this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with the lowest LV.

PB39-XX01.name: The ThreeFoolishBirds Larpentandad
PB39-XX01.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your counter increases via your "Pentan" effect, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, you can draw a card from the deckbottom. Also, (Once per Game: Same Name) if you have five counters or more, you can put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
If you have eight counters or more, and you control any "The Partner Pentan", including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

PB39-CX01.name: The Partner Pentan
PB39-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Pentan" is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +2. Then, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's a "Song Bird" family card with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters, you can summon it without paying the cost. Add any remaining card to the Hand.
